title: Magnetic Structures
description:
Bring Your Imagination To Life!

In the Magnetic Structures game , you can make different magnet 3D structures and enjoy connecting the colourful rods to the metal balls. Each level is designed for you to make a specific structure by following the provided pattern. Pay attention to the details such as colours and location of the parts to make your structure identical to the provided example.

Let the magnet do its work. Use simple tools to build complicated structures.

Bring the spheres and magnet bars together to connect them. As simple as that, this is the basis of the game.

From the bottom of the screen you can activate different options such turning off the gravity; This options can assist you with building larger and more complicated structures.

In order to successfully pass each level, you have to complete the requested structure according to the map. Place each part in its place.

Please note the game is currently in early access, any comment or recommendation would be appreciated so we can consider them upon the full release of the game. Our goal is to make the game-play as enjoyable as possible for the players so leave your recommendation in community-hub , leave a review or directly email them to us.
description_short: Colourful magnetic rods and balls are at your command, Well, everything is ready, so it's time to build. Beautiful 3D magnetic structures will be made by your hands.
